name: io.github.fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt-compact
description: Compact MCP server for SAP ABAP ADT over HTTP, RFC or SNC: one tool per operation, object in args

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ENV_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the .env file that states the destination (the same as the --env-path argument). The file states SAP_URL and SAP_AUTH_TYPE (basic, snc or jwt); a jwt file also states SAP_GRANT_TYPE (authorization_code or none). Without this or --mcp, the server starts in tool-inspection-only mode: nothing is read from the working directory, and SAP_* variables in the process environment alone form no destination.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_BROKER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Base directory of service-keys/ and sessions/ for a named destination chosen with the --mcp argument (one directory; a list is not split). Default: ~/.config/mcp-abap-adt (Documents\mcp-abap-adt on Windows).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Browser for a JWT login: chrome, edge, firefox, system, headless or none.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_BROWSER_AUTH_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Callback port of the JWT browser login, 1-65535.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_UNSAFE
environmentVariables.description: Write a named destination's session to disk (sessions/<name>.env) instead of keeping it in memory.

environmentVariables.name: SAP_CONNECTION_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Connection type: http or rfc. SNC needs rfc (and the SAP NW RFC SDK).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: System type, controls which tools are available (e.g. Programs are onprem-only).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_MASTER_SYSTEM
environmentVariables.description: System context for on-prem create/update operations (system id).

environmentVariables.name: SAP_RESPONSIBLE
environmentVariables.description: Responsible user for on-prem create/update operations.

packageArguments.name: --mcp
packageArguments.description: Named destination: service-keys/<name>.json and sessions/<name>.env under AUTH_BROKER_PATH or the platform directory, read field by field. The working directory's .env is not loaded.
